title: Bridging Semantics and Structure: A Theoretically Grounded Framework for Link Prediction on TAGs
abstract: arXiv:2610.40192v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Link prediction on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) is a fundamental problem with applications in knowledge discovery, recommendation and beyond. Recent progress has highlighted the promise of combining Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with Language Models (LMs) in order to leverage the complementary structural and semantic signals. However, due to the distinct inductive biases of GNNs and LMs, the design of an optimal fusion strategy remains an open research question. In this work, we present Bridge-LP, an intuitive, simple, efficient and theoretically grounded framework that unifies graph and language representations. It is built around three theoretically-justified design components: (D1) jumping connection of textual proximity, which enables robust LM training; (D2) compressed embedding, which encodes neighborhood information long exploited by classical link prediction heuristics, thereby enriching structural signals in a learnable way; and

translated_title: 桥接语义与结构：一个具有理论支撑的文本属性图链接预测框架
translated_abstract: 文本属性图（TAG）上的链接预测是一个基础性问题，在知识发现、推荐系统等领域具有广泛应用。近期的研究进展凸显了将图神经网络（GNN）与语言模型（LM）相结合以利用互补的结构与语义信号的前景。然而，由于GNN和LM具有不同的归纳偏置，如何设计最优的融合策略仍是一个开放性研究问题。在本工作中，我们提出了Bridge-LP——一个直观、简单、高效且具有理论支撑的框架，用于统一图表示与语言表示。该框架围绕三个经过理论论证的设计组件构建：(D1) 文本邻近性跳跃连接，可支持稳健的LM训练；(D2) 压缩嵌入，对经典链接预测启发式方法长期利用的邻域信息进行编码，从而以可学习的方式丰富结构信号；(D3)……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了Bridge-LP框架，通过文本邻近性跳跃连接和压缩嵌入等三个经过理论论证的设计组件，统一图结构信号与语言语义表示，实现了文本属性图上高效且有理论支撑的链接预测。
en_tdlr: Bridge-LP is an intuitive, efficient, and theoretically grounded framework that unifies graph structural and language semantic representations through three theoretically-justified components—including jumping connection of textual proximity and compressed embedding—for link prediction on text-attributed graphs.
